question: door-hardware-sets
unit: ea (per door leaf, one complete hardware set fitted)

band.unit: ea (per door leaf, one complete hardware set fitted)
band.basis: Sum of the components above, per leaf, excl. GST, Auckland 2026, 25 leaves / one floor / one visit. Main drivers (lockset, closer, hinges, door stop) are sourced from QV CostBuilder Hardware rows with NZ vendor benchmarks for the mid-tier equivalents; QV rows are unreviewed and are treated as supply-and-fix unless the section is marked 'Supply Only' (hinges and all door-furniture sections are 'Supply Only'). Allowances (closer backplate, installation labour, keying/restricted cylinder) carry ~12% of the low and ~18% of the high - under the one-third limit. The band is wide and confidence low because QV's library only prices top-tier architectural hardware (LCN designer-cover closers, Legge 990/991 sets with 500-series furniture) while the specified hardware is Grade 2 / EN 1154 size 3 mid-tier: the low end uses NZ vendor prices for mid-tier equivalents, the high end the QV rows. This is a cost-plan band, not a certified price, and it sits well above the $620-$880 suggestion, which appears to reflect lower-tier or older supply pricing. For 25 leaves: ~$33,250 - $58,250 (mid ~$45,700).

band.unit: per leaf (each), one complete hardware set fitted to one already-hung, pre-morticed leaf
band.basis: Sum of distinct components, no double counting: QV Hardware supply rows (mortice lockset incl. both furniture pieces, overhead closer, 3 SS hinges, door stop) + QV Labour Rates carpenter $81.30/hr x 1.5–2.5 hr + web-anchored locksmith keying/keys amortised over 25 + two minor allowances (restricted cylinder uplift, site setup/handover). Lockset and closer are ~70% of the band and are premium architectural-schedule grades; a mid-grade Grade 2 / EN 1154 size 3 equivalent would reduce the band materially, and a NZ supplier cross-check (dormakaba MS2602KX body $128.06 excl GST, handles and cylinder excluded) shows QV sits at the top of the market. QV rows are UNREVIEWED. Allowances carry ~4% of the total. Excludes GST, preliminaries, margin, design/consent fees, the leaf/frame/hanging/machining, access control, fire/smoke hardware, and the leaf hanging. Excluded from this band: the scenario's own $620–$880/leaf, which is not supported by any QV row I could find.

Bottom-up: NZ trade/retail supply of lockset body + satin-SS furniture + cylinder + commercial overhead closer, QV AKL rates for hinges, door stop and carpenter labour, plus allowances for restricted master-keying and handover. Low end = 2019 NZ trade list GST-stripped and escalated +25% with a mainstream retail closer and wall stop; high end = +40% escalation, premium QV LCN closer row, SS floor stop and upper labour. NO QV row exists for a Grade 2 lockset assembly or for keying, so those two are proxy/allowance. QV rows are UNREVIEWED. Allowances are ~4% of the total. Excludes GST, preliminaries, margin, leaf/frame/morticing, access control and fire hardware per the fixed scope. 25 leaves = $26,500-$43,400.
